player_prompt.intro:
Yaa Player {player_id} ({role}) kʋnɛ Matching Pennies kɛlɛ kʋmɛ {num_rounds} la.
- Kʋlɛ kʋlɛ, sɔgɛ [heads] wɛlɛ [tails] (wɛlɛ [h], [t]).
- Yɛm sɔgɛm pʋgɛ yɛm kɛlɛɛm sɔgɛm, Player 0 yaa kʋlɛ kʋmɛ; kɛlɛɛm sɔgɛm pʋgɛ yɛm sɔgɛm, Player 1 yaa kʋlɛ kʋmɛ.
Lɛm sɔgɛm yɛm sɔgɛm '[heads]' wɛlɛ '[tails]' la.

message.round_match: Jɛɛga 0 daa zaɛ '{choice0}'; Jɛɛga 1 daa zaɛ '{choice1}'. Match -> Jɛɛga 0 kɔg
message.round_mismatch: Ninsaaliba 0 yelga {choice0}; Ninsaaliba 1 yelga {choice1}. Ka paasam ba'a -> Ninsaaliba 1 yaa'ra.

outcome.p0_wins: Neb nins sẽn da paam n naagd 0 wã paama b mens sõma.
outcome.p1_wins: Neb nins sẽn da na n wa paam b yõorã yɩɩ wʋsgo.
outcome.draw: B fãa sẽn wa n naagd taabã yaa taaba.
